g.text: A relational database schema for a multi-vendor e-commerce platform where users can create and manage their own stores, publish products, browse different vendors, and purchase products.
Product details, pricing, inventory, and availability.
Purchased products, quantities, and historical prices.
Payment methods, gateway transactions, and payment statuses.
Wallet deposits, withdrawals, purchases, and refunds.
Legacy SHA-256 hashes are accepted and transparently upgraded on login.
Login issues stateless JWT access tokens; sessions and tokens are not persisted.
environment variable, not a database column.
Auth introduced no new tables or columns.
Status values are constrained for stores, products, carts, orders, store orders, payments, and wallet transactions.
Wallet transaction types are limited to
Unique: one wallet per user, unique cart items per product, one store portion per order.
Schema changes are managed by Alembic; tables are no longer created at startup.
The design uses primary keys, foreign keys, and relational constraints to maintain data integrity and support scalable marketplace operations.
This is an expermintal project for mentoring
